layers: B12X selection cache: sparkring_b12x_selection_cache.py and its .pth file in site-packages replace PreparationJob._lookup in memory so that, when tuning is sharded across ranks, it reads the selection cache once the ranks have reconciled it; B12X package files, which the prepared RoCE transport verifies, are unchanged (integrations/b12x/selection_cache). Runtime-status 0.3.2 (source commit fc31b66c3aa006e8f478413dfca4c17cc0aeb20a, wheel 1fca6e26cb55) replaces 0.3.1 in /opt/sparkring/python; its views show the served model name. The image's composition_sha256 still names the 0.3.1 composition. /opt/sparkring/receipts/derived-b12xcache-status032.json records every added, replaced and removed file
